summary: Targeted frontend test of the Rakhigarhi hero red accent line fix, using new script /app/tests/iter22_rak_hero_accent_line.py: 70/87 passed, and almost all failures come from one root cause. HORIZONTAL fix WORKS. In the default layout and with saved production-style offsets (eyebrow translateX 60 / width 1270, heading translateX 61 / 32px / width 1269), at 1920, 1280, 768 and 390 the line's left edge equals the eyebrow's left edge exactly (1920 prod: 350.41 = 350.41, which was the original 60px mismatch). The line is 42x2, sits 30px above the eyebrow, is ruby, and is a single element with no visible parent ::before. VERTICAL REGRESSION (HIGH): the new padding-top reservation on .rak-hero-copy computes to 0px at every viewport. So the whole hero (eyebrow, heading, photos, and the content below) sits 32px higher than with the original CSS (1920: eyebrow top 173 vs legacy 205), and the line sits at 141 instead of 173, outside the copy box. Editor: clicking the line selects the eyebrow ('SMALL LABEL'), and only the inner [data-edit-text] is contenteditable. Drag moves line and text together exactly (dx 43, dy 26.8), with no heading or image movement. Move X +15, undo and redo are exact. Save to the TEST_ clone returned 200, and a fresh public reload matches the editor geometry exactly. Global red-line vars (local style tag 80/5/12) apply to the line, and Haveli follows them too. Haveli and Ambition ::after lines are unchanged (42x2, gap 30). No horizontal overflow at any viewport. No React errors or pageerrors. 0 blocked writes. The real rakhigarhi page fingerprint and the settings fingerprint are unchanged. Clone deleted. Final capture: ready, 10 pages, no TEST_, checksum OK.

ui_bugs.issue: The padding-top reservation is overridden. boxed-layout.css line 428 'html body #public-site#public-site#public-site #rakhigarhi-reference .rak-hero-copy { padding: 0 !important }' has IDENTICAL specificity and loads later (index.js imports boxed-layout after rakhigarhi-reference), so the computed padding-top is 0px. Result: eyebrow, heading and photos (and the rest of the page) move up 32px compared with before the fix, at 1920, 1280, 768 and 390. The line now sits 32px above the copy box. With the header vars set to 5/12 the padding is still 0 (expected 17).

ui_bugs.component: LiveEditor inline edit after clicking the accent line
ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the line selects the eyebrow and makes the inner span contenteditable, but focus ends on <main tabindex=-1>, not on the span, so typing right away does nothing. The user must click the text again.

ui_bugs.component: LiveEditor inline text commit (pre-existing, not caused by this fix)
ui_bugs.issue: record() uses el.innerText, which applies CSS text-transform. Renaming the uppercase hero eyebrow 'Rakhigarhi' to 'Rakhigarhi X' saved 'RAKHIGARHI X' to the data. It looks the same while uppercase is applied, but the stored casing is lost.

action_items: HIGH: make the padding reservation win over boxed-layout.css:428. For example, add one more #public-site to the rule in rakhigarhi-reference.css line 24, or move the rule into boxed-layout.css after line 428. In-browser DIAG verified that 'html body #public-site#public-site#public-site#public-site #rakhigarhi-reference .rak-hero-copy { padding-top: calc(var(--accent-line) + var(--accent-line-gap)) !important }' gives positions identical to the legacy ::before layout at all 4 viewports (1920 eyebrow 205 = 205, line 173 = 173; 1280 192.19; 768/390 155).
LOW: after a click on .rak-hero-accent, focus the [data-edit-text] span (for example preventDefault on pointerdown on the aria-hidden line, or re-focus after the click).
LOW (pre-existing): use textContent, or innerText with the transform neutralised, when committing inline plain-text edits, so text-transform casing is not baked into the data.
critical_code_review_comments: accent-lines.css:28 and site-overrides.css:44 still list #rakhigarhi-reference .rak-hero-copy::before. This is harmless because content is none, but it is a dead selector. Consider pointing it at .rak-hero-accent for clarity.
Arrow-key nudge is disabled for text fields (isText), so the eyebrow can only be nudged by drag or the Move X/Y inputs. Both were verified working.

success_rate.frontend: 70/87 (17 failures: 13 from the single padding-specificity root cause; 2 from the uppercase-casing commit (pre-existing, it also fails the DB/fresh-label checks); 1 low focus issue). All checks of horizontal alignment, movement, editor, save and isolation pass.

The LEGACY style injection hides .rak-hero-accent and restores the parent ::before as the baseline. DIAG lines test the proposed specificity fix. Use textContent, not innerText, for the label: the eyebrow is uppercase via CSS. The Move X input sits inside a collapsed <details>, which the script opens. After the padding fix, the 'DEF ... padding-top 32px' and 'identical to legacy' checks should pass. Expect 'ED rename' / 'DB clone' / 'FRESH label' to keep failing until the innerText casing issue is fixed, unless the assertion is relaxed.
rca of the issue: Root cause: specificity tie in CSS. rakhigarhi-reference.css:24 (html body + 4 ids + 1 class) ties with boxed-layout.css:428 (the same selector shape), and boxed-layout is imported later in index.js, so 'padding: 0 !important' wins. Reproduction: open /our-work/rakhigarhi and read getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#rakhigarhi-reference .rak-hero-copy')).paddingTop, which returns '0px'. Mitigation: raise specificity by one id, or place the rule after boxed-layout.css:428.
